newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aalberts issues shares to buy German firm.
newsitem.headline: Aalberts issues shares to buy German firm.

text.p: Industrial components firm Aalberts Industries NV said it planned to acquire 90 pct of the shares in German metal-hardening firm Harterei Hauck.
Aalberts said it would issue one million new shares to pay for the acquisition, adding that the deal would make an immediate contribution to growth of its earnings per share.
Aalberts said Harterei Hauck GmbH & Co KG had annual sales of some 40 million guilders and was the biggest and most advanced company in its field in Germany.
The Dutch company said the deal would roughly double the annual turnover of its European metal-hardening business to some 80 million guilders.
Aalberts already has metal-hardening businesses in the Netherlands and southern Germany.
